svg.title: Sceaf Personal Yacht - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Adventure Class Ships (2023), printed 142-143, PDF 143-144. Combined decks aligned at stern and machinery: broad lower forward hull, midbody fins, narrower upper body and aft outrigger pods. Right fin partly clipped in plan; reflected from left with illustration corroboration. Pod alignment interpreted; preserves two distinct lateral pairs.
